newsitem.title: USA: Chip card market to quadruple by 2001 - Dataquest.
newsitem.headline: Chip card market to quadruple by 2001 - Dataquest.

text.p: Dataquest Inc said Tuesday that it expects worldwide chip card shipments to expand to 3.4 billion units by 2001 from 774 million units in 1996.
The market research firm said the top-selling region for chip cards is Europe, which accounted for 90 percent of chip-card sales in 1995, Dataquest said.

Chip cards cards are flat, plastic cards, the size of a credit card, that can perform the duties of pocket change, paper money, and debit and credit cards. These cards can also serve as a means identification, access, or payment, Dataquest said.

"Although some standards issues, infrastructure issues, and software issues remain to be resolved, chip cards hold the promise of being one of the world's highest-volume markets for semiconductors," said Jonathan Cassell, industry analyst in Dataquest's Semiconductor Application Markets Worldwide program.
